snippet.title: COLORFALL - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A chaotic 1-4 player co-op match-3 game where you and your friends each control only 1 color. Survive the falling grid by pulling and throwing orbs to trigger chains and finish tasks before time runs out. If your color piles up, it’s on you to clear the path.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4551220/COLORFALL/
